meta.name: fix-what-i-pointed-at
meta.description: Pick up the bugs a human flagged by pointing at them in the running app, each arriving with the element, the note they typed, and the source file and line. Use when the user says they marked or flagged something, when starting a session on an app someone has been clicking through, when a designer or PM has left feedback in the UI, or when the user describes a problem as "that button there" without saying which file.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 指着界面上的毛病,就能拿到对应的源码文件和行号去修
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果有人在运行中的页面上标了问题却说不清是哪个文件
copy.tagline_en: Point at a glitch in the running app and get the exact source file and line to fix
copy.fit_line_en: For you if teammates flag issues in the live UI but can't say which file to open

howto.what: 接上 Reticle 后，Claude 会读取你在运行中应用里标记的 bug（元素、你写的留言、源代码文件与行号），逐条定位修改，再回到应用里验证，确认后把该标记标为已解决。
howto.when: 当用户说自己标记或标注了某处，或在一个别人已经点过的应用上开始新会话，或用户用「那个按钮」指问题却不说文件时接管。

say.text: 我标了几个问题，读一下标记列表
say.note: 列出每条标记的元素、留言和 file:line

say.text: 修掉这个标记，改完在应用里验证，再标已解决
say.note: 按标记修复、验证后 resolve

say.text: 这条我修不了，说明原因但先别标已解决
say.note: 留下未解决的标记并说明理由

howto.what_en: With Reticle, Claude reads the bugs you flagged in the running app — each with the element, your note, and the source file and line — fixes them, verifies the fix in the app, then resolves the mark.
howto.when_en: Use when the user says they flagged something, when starting a session on an app someone has clicked through, or when a problem is described as "that button there" with no file named.

say_en.text: I flagged a few things — read the mark list
say_en.note: Lists each mark's element, note, and file:line

say_en.text: Fix this mark, verify it in the app, then resolve it
say_en.note: Edit, verify, then resolve the mark

say_en.text: I can't fix this one — explain why, leave it unresolved
say_en.note: Leaves the mark open with a reason
